chapter: Jaco, honors, teaching and looking ahead
title: Meeting Jaco Pastorius in Berlin, 1979
summary: At a Berlin festival press conference Jaco said he wanted to do a duo with Toots.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Well, let’s first see… tell you how I met, how we met and how we… he asked to meet me, so to speak. He was… there was just at the dissolution of the Weather Report. And Jaco was doing a single. [laughs] And I was in Berlin, I think it was, whatever [inaudible] years.

’79. And I was representing Belgium in the festival with the three musicians from, all of them Belgian. And at the press conference, somebody asked Jaco: “Mr. Pastorius, you see the menus of… and the menu of everybody who plays at this thing. But if you was to do a duo with somebody, who would you… would be your idea?” “Get me Toots.” That’s true. He said that. “Get me Toots.” Somebody told me that. “Get me Toots.” That’s what happened. And then we played Sophisticated Lady in Berlin. That was not [inaudible]. And then later on when he made… No. I wouldn’t record it in a studio. We played it…
